stemMd: An ellipse has equation $x^2/25+y^2/9=1$. How long is its major axis?
explanationMd: The larger denominator is 25, giving major semiaxis length 5 along x. The full major axis extends from −5 to 5 and has length 10.

distractorRationale.a: This is the major semiaxis, half the full axis.
distractorRationale.d: This is the squared major semiaxis.
distractorRationale.b: This is the minor axis length.
